rules.IDF: Security asks date of birth (DOB) then house number (HOUSE_NO).
rules.IDW: The fourth failed answer in total ends security.
rules.IDFMT: Date of birth is sent as YYYYMMDD with no separators.
rules.CAL: Business days are Monday to Friday except the Society holidays in 5.2.
rules.CB: Callback today or next business day, 09:00 to 19:30 inclusive (memo changed 17:00 to 19:30), later than now.
rules.DL: Band A: 8th business day; band B: 10th business day, but 6th for an instalment loan (memo).
rules.FL: Floor is min_repay for revolving credit, scheduled_instalment for an instalment loan.
rules.ATT: Attempt totals 2 (A) and 3 (B) include the opening ask, so 1 and 2 proposals follow it.
rules.LAD: After the opening ask: full arrears on the 3rd business day; then the floor on the band's latest date.
rules.DSP: Disputes (memo): N-DSP note, transfer to Q-DSP, close D30/DQ.
rules.HU: Insisted request for a person: transfer to Q-GEN, close D30/HU.
rules.PAID: Already paid: N-PCL note, close D20 with no sub-code.
rules.NOTE: Only hardship, dispute and paid claims are noted.
